name: Fallen Sky Lake
summary: At Fallen Sky Lake, a moonstone may be the only hope for Relara, whose fever has broken but whose strength is nearly gone. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, sends you to the waters southeast of Astranaar, where a corrupted Shadethicket Oracle guards the fallen stones.

sections.title: A Daughter's Fading Breaths
sections.body: Pelturas Whitemoon has watched his young daughter, Relara, slip closer to death through days of illness. Remedies made from Bathran's hair and stardust broke her raging fever, but left her body hollow and frail. Pelturas fears she has only breaths remaining before her spirit fades permanently into the night.

sections.title: The Fallen Moonstone
sections.body: Pelturas turns to moonstones to restore Relara's strength. These celestial fragments once fell into Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar, and night elves gathered them for their healing power. Aggressive elementals or corrupted bark now claim the stones, so gathering one means facing danger with blade and spell.

sections.title: The Shadethicket Domain
sections.body: Night elves lost easy access to Fallen Sky Lake when Shadethicket bog beasts claimed the surrounding wilderness. Their leader, the Shadethicket Oracle, hoards the fallen moonstones on an islet in the lake's center. To reclaim one, you must confront and slay the Oracle before Relara's strength runs out. Pelturas crushes the recovered stone into tea, and Relara drinks it and regains her strength.

faq.q: Why does Relara need a moonstone if her fever already broke?
faq.answer: Relara's fever drained her life force so severely that rest alone cannot revive her. Pelturas believes only a fallen moonstone's restorative power can renew her depleted spirit before she succumbs to exhaustion.

faq.q: Where is Fallen Sky Lake located?
faq.answer: Fallen Sky Lake lies in central-eastern Ashenvale, southeast of Astranaar. Hostile bog beasts dominate its waters, which hold a small island at their center.
The Shadethicket Oracle, leader of the hostile bog beasts at the lake, holds the moonstone. The Oracle lairs on an island in the center of Fallen Sky Lake.
This is the final step in Pelturas's search for a remedy. He needs a fallen moonstone to restore Relara's strength, and her fate is revealed when the stone is delivered.

faq.q: Why are the Shadethickets hoarding the moonstones?
faq.answer: As Ashenvale's wild creatures and bog beasts grow more volatile and corrupted, the Shadethickets begin violently driving off outsiders. Their Oracle gathers and guards the lunar relics, keeping them from the night elves of Astranaar.

faq.q: What previous quests lead up to this task?
faq.answer: The chain begins with Bathran's Hair, followed by Orendil's Cure, Elune's Tear, and The Ruins of Stardust. Each step gathers rare components to treat Relara's worsening condition.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, protecting Astranaar's young is a sacred duty shared by the community. Retrieving moonstones tied to Elune's blessings is an act of mercy and reverence.
The hostile Shadethicket bog beasts show the tragic discord spreading through Ashenvale's natural guardians. Facing them weighs heavily on those seeking to restore balance.
Fallen moonstones are sought for their divine energies. Their healing grace, tied to the Moon Goddess Elune, can help save a dying child.
Helping Pelturas Whitemoon supports the Alliance's duty to defend Astranaar's citizens from the creeping corruption overtaking Ashenvale.
